title: Denial cache key omits identity type — anonymous:0 and render:0 collide
description: Denial cache key lacks identity type field. Anonymous users and render service both get identifier "0", causing cache collisions. Anonymous denied dashboards:read poisons render service's read check within 30s, breaking image rendering for restricted dashboards; reverse also holds for write.

title: Should deny on explicit cache deny entry passes with the denial cache removed
description: Test seeded scope map has false values that grant nothing, not the true values needed to test the cache deny short-circuit. Test passes even with denial cache removed, so Check's denial cache short-circuit at service.go:117 is untested.

title: Dead cacheHit scaffolding left in TestService_getUserPermissions
description: cacheHit field is false in both remaining test cases; seeding block (lines 367–369) and assertion (lines 388–390) are unreachable. Cached path is no longer tested but future readers will assume it is.
